lines: Too sloppy! I see an opening!
Shikanosuke collapsed to the gym floor and the training match ended with my victory.
Awww, I just can't beat the likes of you, Fuma.
Don't underestimate me. Because I have this.
I pointed at my head while looking down on Shikanosuke, who was plopped down in exhaustion.
What does that have to do with anything. I'm nimbler than you and also get better grades in martial arts!
What I'm trying to say is your tells are easy to read, Shikanosuke.
The direction you're facing when you dodge, the movements you make when you're about to swing. If you don't fix those tendencies, you'll always be easy to read.
My tendencies... Sakura-sensei told me the same thing. But everything just vanishes from my mind when I stand in front of an opponent.
Well, it's not like I'm that big of deal either though...
Since I had started going on missions, I had personally witnessed the strength of many powerful Taimanin.
Not only Taimanin. UFS soldiers, demons, shady mercenaries...
I had always escaped trouble somehow thanks to Hebiko and our teachers, but I felt my own lack of combat ability deep in my soul.
(If I could use Ninja Arts, I might be able to strengthen my Taima Kill techniques, but... no way to work with something that I don't have.)
(I need to at least refine my basic martial arts.)
That was why I had called Shikanosuke, who had a similarly unfavorable reputation with regard to practical skills, to train with me.
(If only I could get to the point where I saw myself as a valuable piece on the battlefield...)
Haah... Hey, Fuma, let's take a break.
I sat down beside Shikanosuke, who was still lying on his back on the floor.
By the way, what do you think about Hebiko?
Huh!? What's with that all of a sudden!! What do you even mean, Hebiko is our friend, isn't she!?
True, but recently haven't you thought she's gotten pretty hot?
I've never looked at Hebiko that way.
Then what about that other girl? The one you admire!
Eh!? Who are you talking about!?
The girl from the other class, what was her name... Kamimura Maika? You always stare at her all dreamily when you see her, don't you!?
That's different! I simply admire Kamimura-san! She's stronger than the less-skilled guys and her Ninja Art is pretty cool...
You're right, she is pretty powerful, but you've really got strange tastes.
D-Don't get me wrong!! Kamimura-san is my role model as a Taimanin! Don't filter everything through your warped perspective!
Yeah, if you say so. Then who's your type?
E-Enough already! We're still students, we can think about stuff like that when we're proper Taimanin...
Come on, just tell me! Even you have a type, don't you? Come on.
Fuma, you're too close! You reek of octopus ink!
I had completely gotten used to it and kept forgetting, but the smell from the ink that Hebiko had shot at me in Maesaki City during our day off still hadn't gone away.
So not a girl... but maybe there's a guy you like?
My god, you're persistent! Uhhh... errr, yeah, how about Rinko-senpai!!
Ah~ Rinko-senpai... I get you, she's good looking! Though I haven't seen her in a few days...
(Come to think of it, Mizuki Yukikaze was also looking for Rinko-senpai the other day... is she still not back?)
Isn't she on a mission again? Rinko-senpai is an exceptional student, so she always gets picked to go on missions!
Kamimura Maika and Akiyama Rinko. So I guess you want powerful women to do things to you...
Shuuuut uuuuup!!! Come on, enough with the chit-chat!
Let's resume the training! Next up is weight training! One and two and...
Shikanosuke ended our conversation on his own and continued with the training. He didn't seem to like talking about his love life.
I smiled bitterly at Shikanosuke and started with my weight training as well.
I laid on the floor and closed my eyes for a moment after finishing the hundredth sit-up.
(This is hard... Sheesh, being an ordinary person is tough.)
It might have been because my head didn't get enough blood during the intense training, but with my eyes closed I felt a little light-headed.
(But still, recently training's gotten a bit easier.)
(I might try adding some weights next time... there should be some in the gym storage, I think)
Something hit my already overworked abs and I saw stars for a moment.
Huh? There wasn't anyone here until just now...
To my surprise, Sakura-sensei was sitting on my stomach.
But something was different about Sakura-sensei. She somehow looked a little younger, or something...?
Ugh... you somehow look really young today...
And your legs are so smooth and firm...
With her sitting on top of me, her crotch and thighs where tight against my stomach.
Y-You pervert! And what do you mean I look young!?
Sakura-sensei should be in her 20s right now. She talked and acted quite childishly, but she was still a grown woman.
(But today's Sakura-sensei is somehow fresh and lively like a young girl... and the design of her Taima-Suit is also different...)
Your breasts also look a bit smaller...
Wha-!? The nerve!!! You're a rude one, aren't you! Who the hell are you in the first place!?
Eh!? What do you mean who am I... you're kidding, right? We went to the haunted castle together, didn't we? Right, Shikanosuke? ...Huh, Shikanosuke!?
Shikanosuke, who had been doing weight training with me until a moment ago, wasn't there anymore. Maybe he had gone to the bathroom?
Suspicious... A-ha!!! Now I get it!!!
You're fooling around and trying to trick me!!!
You must be one of the intruders!! *Sniff, sniff*... The octopus smell is proof of that...!
An intruder??? And I smell like this because Hebiko shot her ink at me during the Devildomian Wasp incident...
You also know about that, right? That the smell of Hebiko's ink is really hard to get off.
No more excuses!!! Guys! I found one of the intruders!
Upon Sakura-sensei's signal, several armed Taimanin appeared.
Um, uhh... what are you going to do to me?
Hm? What do you guys want to do? Who wants to eliminate him!?
The Taimanin all raised their hands together. I had never seen them before, but they also must have been students.
It's decided then, we're going to eliminate you!
Aren't you deciding my fate a bit too easily!!!? More importantly, what is going on here?!
I had no idea what was going on... but their thirst for blood seemed legit.
(I need to get out of here for now...)
